label: DFlash speculative decoding on NVIDIA Blackwell

items.title: Boost Inference Performance up to 15x on NVIDIA Blackwell Using DFlash Speculative Decoding - NVIDIA Developer
items.summary_1line: Boost Inference Performance up to 15x on NVIDIA Blackwell Using DFlash Speculative Decoding NVIDIA Developer
items.editor_note: NVIDIA Developer publishes the DFlash speculative-decoding technique, claiming up to 15x inference throughput gains on Blackwell GPUs.

items.title: Achieve state-of-the-art inference latencies with speculative decoding
items.summary_1line: How Modal and Decagon worked together to cut inference latency - and you can too.
items.editor_note: Modal names DFlash as the technique behind its own state-of-the-art latency results, releasing open-source speculator models built with Z Lab and SGLang.

editorial.tldr: Speculative decoding — drafting candidate tokens ahead of the target model to cut serving latency — is a known lever for LLM inference cost. NVIDIA's June 23 developer post introduced DFlash, a speculator built on the target model's own KV projections, claiming up to 15x throughput gains on Blackwell GPUs.
editorial.whats_new: Modal named DFlash as the technique behind its own state-of-the-art inference-latency results, working with Z Lab and SGLang to release open-source pre-trained speculator models — including one for Qwen that improves over multi-token prediction by more than 50%.
editorial.why_it_matters: If you're running inference on Blackwell GPUs with SGLang, this is now an off-the-shelf latency lever: Modal reports that Blackwell plus SGLang plus a low-overhead regional deployment can match or beat proprietary inference providers without custom infra.
editorial.take_for_builders: Running inference on Blackwell with SGLang? Evaluate the open-source DFlash speculator models before building custom speculative decoding — Modal reports it matching proprietary inference-provider latency without proprietary infra.

status.detail: Modal confirms the same DFlash technique in its own latency benchmarks and ships open-source pre-trained speculator models built with Z Lab and SGLang.

beats.summary: Modal reports DFlash as its best-performing speculative-decoding technique, with a Qwen speculator improving over multi-token prediction by 50%+.
